test_title: PYST 190: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 14th Nov,, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Draw first blood

options.text: Be the first to donate blood to help a friend
Agree to accompany someone for the diagnosis of an illness
Take a blood test early in the morning
Be the first to gain an advantage or score against an opponent

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Be the first to gain an advantage or score against an opponent'.**
